edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.lede: Change the alias's name or the port it goes to.
edit.name: Alias
edit.rule: 3 to 61 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, not starting or ending with a dash.
edit.reserved: That name is kept for the platform. Pick another one.
edit.portRule: Type a port number from 1 to 65535.
edit.kit: Hoody uses port {{port}}, so an alias can't go to it.
edit.program: This alias goes to a Hoody program ({{program}}), not to a port. Only its name can be changed here.
edit.reason.name: Fix the alias name to save.
edit.reason.wait: Checking which ports Hoody uses on this computer.
edit.rename: The address changes with the name: {{old}} stops working as soon as this is saved, and links that use it break.
edit.cname: If a domain of yours points at {{old}}, point its DNS record at the new name: the old name becomes free and can be taken by someone else.
edit.taken: That alias name is already in use. Pick another one.
edit.gone: This alias is no longer in the list. Close this and check the Aliases table.
edit.held: A change to the alias {{name}} may already have gone through. Check the list before trying again.
